experiments.hypothesis: Remote DuckDB, Polars and Arrow can reduce transferred bytes while preserving source-faithful results.
experiments.unmet_requirement: Exact representative public Australian Parquet identities and amplification baselines are not yet complete.
experiments.baseline: Pinned anonymous full-object restore with independent SHA-256 verification.
experiments.threshold: Exact result parity with lower transferred bytes and bounded request, latency, and memory amplification.
experiments.rights_sensitivity_review: Only public rights-qualified objects; exclude restricted terminology and credentials.
experiments.fallback: Pinned anonymous object download followed by bounded local DuckDB query.
experiments.rollback: Remove experimental cache and retain the storage-neutral Python 3.14 reader.

experiments.hypothesis: Xet chunk reuse can reduce historical restore transfer without changing object identity.
experiments.unmet_requirement: Two exact public historical objects with anonymous byte verification are required.
experiments.baseline: Two complete pinned-revision restores with independent per-object SHA-256 verification.
experiments.threshold: Lower transferred bytes while both restored objects retain their exact source digests.
experiments.rights_sensitivity_review: Only public redistributable historical objects; cache contains no credentials or restricted bytes.
experiments.fallback: Restore complete objects anonymously and verify per-object SHA-256.
experiments.rollback: Delete the bounded Xet cache; source receipts and object digests remain authoritative.

experiments.hypothesis: Prior Iceberg REST lifecycle evidence remains sufficient until the remote public workload changes.
experiments.unmet_requirement: No changed remote workload currently justifies repeating the bounded result.
experiments.baseline: Previously verified direct Parquet and bounded Iceberg REST lifecycle evidence.
experiments.threshold: Repeat only for a changed remote workload and require parity without replacing source identities.
experiments.rights_sensitivity_review: Register rebuildable metadata only over public rights-qualified Parquet.
experiments.fallback: Read source-faithful Parquet directly without catalogue metadata.
experiments.rollback: Drop the disposable catalogue; retain acquisition and payload identities.

experiments.hypothesis: The prior Merkle fixture remains a valid additive attestation baseline.
experiments.unmet_requirement: Cross-dataset public revisions are not complete for a new federation package.
experiments.baseline: Independent per-object SHA-256 receipts plus the verified prior Merkle fixture.
experiments.threshold: Every leaf and cross-dataset revision verifies; mutation, reordering, omission, and circular provenance fail.
experiments.rights_sensitivity_review: Attest only public object identities and metadata; never duplicate restricted bytes.
experiments.fallback: Verify every object using its independent SHA-256 receipt.
experiments.rollback: Discard additive batch roots without changing object receipts.

experiments.hypothesis: Portable Gold tables can generate deterministic graph and semantic preview projections.
experiments.unmet_requirement: Representative Gold tables and rights-cleared terminology controls are not complete.
experiments.baseline: Direct queries over the canonical portable Gold node and edge tables.
experiments.threshold: Deterministic engine parity with calibrated retrieval and all negative controls passing.
experiments.rights_sensitivity_review: Exclude restricted SNOMED CT-AU and AMT bytes and keep candidates non-authoritative.
experiments.fallback: Query the portable Gold node and edge tables directly.
experiments.rollback: Delete rebuildable graph and index projections.

experiments.hypothesis: Prior DuckLake, Delta and Hudi dispositions remain valid absent a measured high-update workload.
experiments.unmet_requirement: No multi-writer or high-update requirement has been measured.
experiments.baseline: Immutable Parquet, append-only receipts, and embedded DuckDB using prior decision evidence.
experiments.threshold: Reopen only for a measured multi-writer or high-update gap with parity and recovery evidence.
experiments.rights_sensitivity_review: Use synthetic or public rights-qualified fixtures and retain immutable source evidence.
experiments.fallback: Use immutable Parquet plus append-only receipts and embedded DuckDB.
experiments.rollback: Remove optional experiment state and rebuild from immutable evidence.
